", "calendar_core/slots.py": """"Tiny day-planning helpers. Times are minutes after midnight (0-1440).

Rules (the contract every change must keep):

* An Event covers the half-open interval [start, end): it includes its start
  minute and excludes its end minute. start < end is required.
* Two events overlap only if they share at least one minute. Back-to-back
  events (one ends exactly when the next starts) do not overlap.
* free_slots(events, day_start, day_end, min_minutes) returns the gaps inside
  [day_start, day_end) not covered by any event, as (start, end) tuples sorted
  by start. Events may arrive in any order and may overlap each other. Only
  gaps of at least min_minutes are returned. Events partly outside the day
  are clipped to it.
* find_meeting_time(calendars, duration, day_start, day_end) returns the
  earliest (start, start + duration) inside [day_start, day_end) not covered
  by any event on any calendar, or None if no such time exists. duration
  must be a positive integer, otherwise ValueError is raised.
* parse_time turns "HH:MM" (24-hour) or 12-hour times like "9am" / "2:30pm"
  into minutes. Anything it cannot parse raises ValueError.
* fmt_duration(minutes) renders "Xh YYm" (e.g. 65 -> "1h 05m", 45 -> "0h 45m").
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass

MINUTES_PER_DAY = 1440


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Event:
    start: int
    end: int
    title: str = ""

    def __post_init__(self):
        if not (0 <= self.start < self.end <= MINUTES_PER_DAY):
            raise ValueError(f"bad event times {self.start}-{self.end}")


def parse_time(text: str) -> int:
    """Parse "HH:MM" (24-hour) or 12-hour times like "9am" / "2:30pm" into minutes after midnight."""
    stripped = text.strip()
    lowered = stripped.lower()
    if lowered.endswith(("am", "pm")):
        suffix = lowered[-2:]
        body = stripped[:-2].strip()
        if not body:
            raise ValueError(f"bad time {text!r}")
        if ":" in body:
            hours, minutes = body.split(":")
            h, m = int(hours), int(minutes)
        else:
            h, m = int(body), 0
        if not (1 <= h <= 12 and 0 <= m < 60):
            raise ValueError(f"bad time {text!r}")
        if suffix == "am":
            h = 0 if h == 12 else h
        elif h != 12:
            h += 12
        return h * 60 + m
    hours, minutes = text.strip().split(":")
    h, m = int(hours), int(minutes)
    if not (0 <= h < 24 and 0 <= m < 60):
        raise ValueError(f"bad time {text!r}")
    return h * 60 + m


def overlaps(a: Event, b: Event) -> bool:
    """True if the two events share at least one minute."""
    return a.start < b.end and b.start < a.end


def free_slots(events: list[Event], day_start: int, day_end: int, min_minutes: int = 1) -> list[tuple[int, int]]:
    """Gaps of at least min_minutes inside [day_start, day_end) not covered by any event."""
    clipped = []
    for ev in events:
        start = max(ev.start, day_start)
        end = min(ev.end, day_end)
        if start < end:
            clipped.append((start, end))
    clipped.sort()

    slots = []
    cursor = day_start
    for start, end in clipped:
        if start > cursor:
            slots.append((cursor, start))
        cursor = max(cursor, end)
    if cursor < day_end:
        slots.append((cursor, day_end))
    return [(s, e) for s, e in slots if e - s >= min_minutes]


def find_meeting_time(calendars: list[list[Event]], duration: int, day_start: int, day_end: int) -> tuple[int, int] | None:
    """Earliest (start, start + duration) inside [day_start, day_end) free on every calendar."""
    if isinstance(duration, bool) or not isinstance(duration, int) or duration <= 0:
        raise ValueError(f"duration must be a positive integer, got {duration!r}")
    all_events = [event for calendar in calendars for event in calendar]
    slots = free_slots(all_events, day_start, day_end, min_minutes=duration)
    if not slots:
        return None
    start = slots[0][0]
    return (start, start + duration)


def fmt_duration(minutes: int) -> str:
    """Render minutes as "Xh YYm"."""
    return f"{minutes // 60}h {minutes % 60:02d}m"
